messages:
Priya S: Quick chase — following up on open postmortem action items from INC-2025-03. Three items still showing as open in the tracker:

- AI-45 (router retry): owner Matt L, due 2025-02-28 — status: waiting on infra kernel bump
- AI-77 (kv-cache eviction): owner Asha R, due 2025-02-20 — status: in QA
- AI-89 (alerting thresholds): owner Jess K, due 2025-03-03 — status: unclaimed

Can folks post quick updates here so I can escalate / close items by EOD Fri? @Sam G FYI.

Matt L: I’m blocked on the kernel that infra promised. PR: https://git.internal/r/inference/patches/321 — infra said ETA 24h. Will update when merged.

Asha R: AI-77 — ✅ fix deployed to staging at 10:12 UTC, smoke tests green. Verified metrics: 99.9% hit rate on prefix cache. Drove one quick query: `curl -s https://staging.redwood/api/health | jq .cache` -> "ok"

Jess K: I can pick up AI-89. Will set thresholds and add alert runbook. Targeting 2025-03-02 for initial rollout, can we get a quick review?

OpsBot: Escalation notice: AI-45 overdue by 2d. Notifying manager Sam G.

Sam G: Thanks — Matt, if infra ETA slips, please move AI-45 to "blocked-by-infra" and ping @eng-infra to avoid chasing repeatedly. Also please add a fallback mitigation plan in the tracker.

Matt L: Kernel patch landed on infra nodes at 11:05 UTC and I restarted inference replica set:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
```
Rolling logs show warmup complete.

Priya S: Great — Matt, once you confirm prod smoke tests are green, mark AI-45 as ready-for-verify. Asha, Jess — please add short verification steps in the tracker so I can close after verification. Also adding note to the postmortem: recurring pattern: cache eviction + router retry happening together. We should schedule a mini-blitz to codify mitigations.

Jess K: AI-89 done — thresholds added, alert runbook linked: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-03/runbook. Marking complete.

Matt L: Prod smoke OK at 11:27 UTC. Latency back to baseline, no regressions. Marked AI-45 -> ready-for-verify.

Priya S: Thanks all — I'll run the verification checklist and close AI-45 and AI-77 by EOD. If anyone sees outstanding items, flag here. :thumbsup:
